title: Starlight Odyssey
short_plot_summary: A crew of astronauts embarks on a mind-bending journey through a newly discovered wormhole, encountering strange new worlds and testing the limits of human endurance. It feels epic and awe-inspiring, but is surprisingly safe for older kids and has very low violence.

title: The Last Laugh
short_plot_summary: A washed-up stand-up comedian takes on a protégé, leading to a hilarious, gritty, and often dark road trip across the country. It's fast-paced, cynical, and full of biting sarcasm.

title: Autumn Whispers
short_plot_summary: Two childhood friends reconnect in their small hometown during the fall season. It's a heartwarming, cozy, and relaxing romantic movie that won't make you cry, focusing purely on sweet, uplifting moments.

title: Neon Grid
short_plot_summary: In a cyberpunk future, a rogue hacker must navigate a neon-lit, gritty metropolis to dismantle an evil megacorporation. It's an intense, visually stunning action movie with blade-runner vibes and thrilling, violent combat.

title: The Golden Cipher
short_plot_summary: A group of teenage misfits discovers an ancient map that leads to a legendary pirate's treasure. It's a classic 80s adventure movie involving treasure hunting, filled with traps, puzzles, and lighthearted fun.

title: Midnight Inception
short_plot_summary: A thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a C.E.O. It's a cerebral, complex, and suspenseful heist movie.

title: Echoes of the Glen
short_plot_summary: A peaceful historical drama set in the Scottish Highlands following a family's struggles and triumphs over a decade. It's slow-paced, visually beautiful, and deeply emotional but avoids tragedy.

title: Velocity Protocol
short_plot_summary: A secret agent must stop a biological threat by engaging in high-speed chases across European capitals. It's a very fast-paced action movie that's relatively safe with spectacular stunts but no gore.

title: Shadows of the Manor
short_plot_summary: A family moves into an old, isolated estate only to discover it's haunted by a malevolent entity. It's a terrifying, psychological horror film that is extremely tense and definitely not relaxing.

title: Galactic Pioneers
short_plot_summary: A plucky robot is left to clean up a deserted Earth until he meets a sleek probe and follows her into space. It's a charming, family-friendly animated sci-fi film that is very heartwarming.

title: The Dusty Trail
short_plot_summary: A lone gunslinger arrives in a corrupt town and plays two rival families against each other. It's a classic, gritty spaghetti western with an iconic soundtrack.

title: City Limiters
short_plot_summary: An insightful look into how urban planners are designing smart cities for the future to combat climate change. It's educational, inspiring, and very relaxing to watch.

title: Sword of the Ancestors
short_plot_summary: A young farm boy discovers he is the heir to a magical kingdom and must journey across middle-earth to defeat a dark lord. It's an epic, sweeping fantasy adventure with grand battles.

title: Office Shenanigans
short_plot_summary: Software engineers miserable at their corporate jobs decide to enact a scheme to steal fractions of cents from their company. It's a deeply relatable, satirical workplace comedy.

title: Rhythm and Blues
short_plot_summary: A jazz pianist and an aspiring actress fall in love while pursuing their dreams in Los Angeles. It's a romantic, visually vibrant musical with both joyful and melancholic moments.
